name: markdown-vista
description: Enhances the built-in Markdown preview: Mermaid diagrams, extended syntax, and a zoom/pan viewer for every diagram, image and formula.

markdownVista.mermaid.enabled.description: Render ```mermaid code fences as diagrams in the Markdown preview.

markdownVista.extendedSyntax.enabled.description: Enable ==mark==, ++ins++, ~sub~, ^sup^, footnotes, definition lists, abbreviations and :emoji: shortcodes. (Math, task lists and heading anchors are already built into VS Code.)

markdownVista.toc.enabled.description: Show the table-of-contents button in the Markdown preview.

markdownVista.toc.openByDefault.description: Open the table of contents automatically when a preview opens.

markdownVista.toc.maxLevel.description: Deepest heading level listed in the table of contents.

markdownVista.viewer.enabled.description: Click a diagram, image or formula in the preview to open the zoom/pan viewer.

markdownVista.viewer.includeImages.description: Include plain images (png/jpg/webp/svg) in the zoom viewer.

markdownVista.viewer.includeMath.description: Include KaTeX display formulas in the zoom viewer.

markdownVista.viewer.minimap.description: Show the navigation minimap while zoomed in.

enumDescriptions: Try a real file download first, fall back to copying to the clipboard.
Always use a file download (may be blocked by the preview's security policy).
Always copy the PNG to the clipboard.
markdownVista.viewer.pngExport.description: How the viewer exports the current graphic as a PNG.

markdownVista.mermaid.errorDetails.description: Show the Mermaid parser error and line number when a diagram fails, instead of a generic message.

markdownVista.code.copyButton.description: Show a copy button on code blocks.

markdownVista.code.foldOver.description: Collapse code blocks longer than this many lines. 0 disables folding.

markdownVista.docLinks.enabled.description: Turn plain-text references to other Markdown files into links.

markdownVista.docLinks.pattern.description: Regular expression matching a document reference. The first capture group is the file path, resolved relative to the current document.

markdownVista.reading.maxWidth.description: Maximum width of body text in pixels; code blocks, tables and diagrams stay full width. 0 uses the full pane.

markdownVista.breadcrumb.enabled.description: Show the path of the current section in a bar at the top of the preview.

markdownVista.sectionFolding.enabled.description: Show a fold control on headings to collapse a section in the preview.

enumDescriptions: Scroll to the heading and hold the position against anything that scrolls it away.
Navigate to the heading anchor and let the built-in preview do the scrolling.
markdownVista.toc.jumpStrategy.description: How clicking a table-of-contents entry moves the preview.

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run verify && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies
